sections.title: Risk Factors
sections.excerpt: Risk factors An investment in our securities involves substantial risks. See “Risk Factors” and the other information included in this prospectus for a discussion of the factors you should consider carefully before deciding to invest in our securities. Listing Our Class A Common Stock is listed on The Nasdaq Capital Market and trades under the symbol “PARA.” We do not intend to list the Warrants offered hereunder on any stock exchange. There are no established public trading markets for the Warrants, and we do not expect such markets to develop. Without an active trading market, the liquidity of the Warrants will be limited. sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt: Dividend Policy As of the date of this prospectus, we have not declared or paid any cash dividends on our Common Stock. We expect to retain future earnings, if any, for future operations, expansion and debt repayment and have no plans to declare or pay cash dividends on our Common Stock for the foreseeable future. Any decision to declare and pay dividends in the future will be made at the discretion of the Board and will depend on, among other things, our results of operations, financial condition, cash requirements, contractual restrictions, and other factors that the Board may deem relevant.
